what_happened.line: The Select Board heard a town manager statement that two Board of Assessors members had resigned, leaving that board without a quorum.
The board and town manager called for volunteers to fill the assessor seats, to register interest through the town manager's executive assistant.
The Select Board asked former assessors to serve on an interim basis through the next May election.
The assessors' meeting time was described as the assessors' own decision, not the Select Board's; a speaker said it may move to another day.
No votes were recorded; routine warrants were read, and an adjournment motion was made with its outcome not audible.

why_it_matters: The Board of Assessors sets property valuations that feed the tax bill, so a board without a quorum can stall that work until the seats are filled.
Residents can volunteer for the vacancies, and interim appointees are meant to serve only until the May election, when the seats would be on the ballot.
watch_next: Whether the two assessor seats are filled on an interim basis, and by whom.
The next May election, when the interim arrangement is meant to end.
